## Master Product Silos & Categories
- **Ropes & Cordage**: Manila Natural Fiber Rope, Polypropylene (PP) Danline 3-Strand Rope, Nylon Braided Rope, High-Tenacity Polyester Rigging Cord.
- **Nets & Mesh**: 75% Agricultural Green Shade Netting (Hara Parda), Heavy-Duty Construction Safety Debris Netting, Anti-Bird Cargo Mesh.
- **Webbing & Cargo Control**: Polyester Webbing Lifting Slings (1-10 Ton, 2-Ply & 4-Ply), Heavy-Duty Ratchet Cargo Tie-Down Belts.
- **Tarpaulins & Covers**: Waterproof High-Density HDPE Tarpaulins (Tarpal), Industrial Wax-Treated Heavy Cotton Canvas Tarpaulins.
- **Flexible & Suction Pipes**: Flexible Deep-Well Boring Suction Pipes, Industrial Heliflex Heavy Water Delivery Hose, Reinforced PVC Tubing.
- **Polymers & Granules**: Virgin & Reprocessed Polyethylene (HDPE/LDPE/LLDPE), Polypropylene (PP) Injection/Raffia Granules, PVC Compound.
- **Industrial Strapping**: Polypropylene (PP) Semi-Automatic Box Strapping, High-Tensile PET Steel-Replacement Strapping, Galvanized Metal Strapping Seals (Patti Kundi).
